import json
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/billing/billing.db'
SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/billing/scripts/recalc_tax.py'
PDF_DIR = '/var/billing/invoices'
SUPERSEDED_DIR = '/var/billing/invoices/superseded'

@function_tool
def run_invoice_recalculation(invoice_number: str) -> dict:
    proc = subprocess.run(['python3', SCRIPT_PATH, '--invoice', invoice_number, '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return {'ok': False, 'error': proc.stderr.strip()}
    values = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    # Move the previously rendered PDF out of the active folder since it is now stale
    safe_name = os.path.basename(invoice_number)
    old_pdf = os.path.join(PDF_DIR, f'{safe_name}.pdf')
    if os.path.exists(old_pdf):
        os.makedirs(SUPERSEDED_DIR, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.move(old_pdf, os.path.join(SUPERSEDED_DIR, f'{safe_name}.pdf'))
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    with conn:
        conn.execute('UPDATE invoices SET tax_cents = ?, total_cents = ? WHERE invoice_number = ?', (values['tax_cents'], values['total_cents'], invoice_number))
    conn.close()
    return {'ok': True, 'invoice_number': invoice_number, 'tax_cents': values['tax_cents'], 'total_cents': values['total_cents']}
